candidate_relations.reason: Idiopathic premature ventricular complexes capture the short-coupled PVCs but omit polymorphic VT/VF as an IVF variant.
Ryanodine receptor 2 mutation records a VUS, not the short-coupled PMVT/VF clinical diagnosis.
CPVT is a related RyR2 arrhythmia but conflicts with rest-onset short-coupled PMVT/VF rather than catecholaminergic bidirectional VT.
ARVC conflicts with normal echocardiography and is not idiopathic short-coupled VF.

case_quality_flags: RyR2 variant is of unknown significance and does not by itself establish CPVT or the short-coupled IVF diagnosis
